datasets.description: Malawi Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/malawi_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2020 in Malawi. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases mapped to geographic areas, indicating the severity and spatial distribution of food insecurity as a consequence of underlying hazards (primarily drought). Data are provided in GeoJSON and KML formats for each month.

sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
